title: Add source alpha installer
summary: Distribution remains planned even though the alpha boundary is source-built. Add a local source installer that builds the daemon and CLI into an operator-selected prefix, records an install manifest, and documents the unsupported packaging boundary without claiming signed release artifacts or stable SDKs.
expectedFailureModes: Installer writes outside the requested prefix or depends on machine-local absolute paths.
Installer output implies signed release artifacts, package-manager support, or stable SDK guarantees that do not exist.
Dry-run and validation paths drift from the real install plan, making alpha setup evidence unreliable.
nextAction: Define package-manager distribution, signed release artifacts, stable SDK boundaries, and upgrade policy.
